description.en: Deinocheirus mirificus inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m asset art scale not biological measurement. Lee et al2014 RBINS primary Fig1 scaled composite MPC-D100/127 and 128 plus holotype18; Fig2 long narrow skull with flared spatulate snout and deep toothless lower jaw, Fig3 high neural spines and broad blunt pedal unguals. Exact high-back soft tissues uncertain; modest continuous rounded ridge follows skeletal envelope, not asserted fatty hump. Colors, tissue thickness, pose and claws are artistic. No tail fan or conspicuous plumage: feather fan only hypothesized, not preserved. No copied source geometry.
